name: yaml-spec-blocks
description: Cursor-aware, pre-filled YAML blocks driven by a JSON Schema — for dbt property files, with an optional BEAM*/Kimball model spec preset.

scripts.test: npm run -s schemas && tsx test/run.ts && tsx test/insert.ts && tsx test/dbt.ts && tsx test/validate.ts

commands.title: YAML Spec Blocks: Insert Block Here

yamlSpecBlocks.schemaPath.markdownDescription: Schema file (YAML or JSON), absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Empty: `schemas/model_spec.schema.yaml` (or `.json`) in the workspace if present, else the bundled preset (`yamlSpecBlocks.preset`).

markdownEnumDescriptions: Generic dbt property files: dbt Labs' schema plus common blocks.
BEAM*/Kimball model spec: dbt Labs' schema plus the model_spec conventions.
yamlSpecBlocks.preset.markdownDescription: Bundled schema used when the workspace has no schema of its own.

yamlSpecBlocks.include.description: Glob of the model YAML files YAML Spec Blocks works in.

yamlSpecBlocks.suggestOnNewLine.description: Open suggestions automatically when Enter lands on a line where blocks or keys fit.

yamlSpecBlocks.lint.description: Warn about cross-reference problems (definitions vs sources, completes targets).

yamlSpecBlocks.syncJsonSchema.description: When the schema is YAML, keep a .json copy beside it (for the Red Hat YAML extension's validation).
